final: WITH kept AS (SELECT r.name AS race_name, ds.points AS p FROM driverStandings ds JOIN races r ON r.raceId = ds.raceId WHERE ds.points > 1.0), per_name AS (SELECT race_name, AVG(p) AS avg_p FROM kept GROUP BY race_name), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_p) AS overall_avg FROM per_name WHERE avg_p IS NOT NULL) SELECT pn.race_name, pn.avg_p, pn.avg_p - o.overall_avg AS diff_from_overall FROM per_name pn, overall o WHERE o.overall_avg IS NOT NULL AND pn.avg_p > o.overall_avg
